name: recall
description: Recall - a personal memory and task assistant (capture, organize, retrieve, remind).

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @recall/shared && npm run build --workspace @recall/server
scripts.build:all: npm run build --workspace @recall/shared && npm run build --workspace @recall/server && npm run build --workspace @recall/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @recall/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @recall/server
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test
